<div class="flipbook">

  <div class="hard">
    <h2>Flip Book</h2>
    <small>by Me</small>
  </div>

  <div class="hard"></div>

  <div>
    <small>Page 1</small>
    <small>This is practice text.</small>
  </div>

  <div>
    <small>Page 2</small>
    <small>What about this page?</small>
  </div>

  <div>
    <small>Page 3</small>
    <small>Don't forget this one too.</small>
  </div>

  <div class="hard"></div>
  <div class="hard"></div>

</div>

<script src="jquery.js"></script>
<script src="turn.js"></script>

<script>
  $(".flipbook").turn();

</script>
